description: All nine drums in one module, with two toms, a CV input for every parameter, and a stereo mixer

params.text: Pitch of that drum
Pitch the transient starts from, above the pitch the drum falls to
Switches the kick between an 808-like and a 909-like circuit
Intensity of the transient at the front of the hit
How long that drum takes to die away
Level of that drum in the mix, with as much as 12dB of gain
Places that drum left or right in the stereo mix, with the pan law of VCV Console
Click to sound that drum once
Decay time of the snare wire envelope
Level of the snare wires; at 0% only the drum is heard
Switches the tom between low, mid and high, which changes the harmonics of the oscillators
How hard that drum is struck
Attack time of the transient that excites the rimshot circuit
Decay time of the transient that excites the rimshot circuit
How much filtering is applied to the clap
Diffusion of the reverb around the clap
Reverb time of the clap
How metallic that cymbal is: at 0% it is close to noise, at 100% resonant and ringing
Level of the stereo mix, from silence to +12dB
How far the voltage at the ACC input accents every drum. With no cable in that input it reads 10V, so this knob alone sets a fixed accent
How far the voltage at the TUNE input shifts the pitch of every drum. With no cable in that input it reads 10V, so this knob alone retunes the whole kit

inputs.text: A trigger here sounds that drum
Modulates the pitch of that drum
Modulates the pitch the transient starts from
Modulates the intensity of the transient
Modulates the decay time of that drum
Modulates the decay of the snare wire envelope
Modulates the level of the snare wires
Modulates how hard that drum is struck
Modulates the attack of the transient that excites the rimshot circuit
Modulates the decay of the transient that excites the rimshot circuit
Modulates the filtering applied to the clap
Modulates the diffusion of the reverb around the clap
Modulates the reverb time of the clap
Modulates how metallic that cymbal is
A voltage here accents every drum as it is triggered
Shifts the pitch of every drum

outputs.text: Left side of the stereo mix
Right side of the stereo mix

notes: there is no sequencer here; a drum sounds only on a trigger at its own trigger input or a click on its button
the kick, the clap and the ride have no pan knob and stay in the centre of the stereo mix
six kit presets, House, House 2, Techno, IDM, Moombah and Lounge, are loaded from the Preset submenu of Rack's own module menu; each is a set of knob positions, not a pattern
